newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch consumer confidence rises in March.
newsitem.headline: Dutch consumer confidence rises in March.

text.p: The Dutch consumer confidence index rose to 13 in March from 12 in February, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Thursday.
DUTCH CONSUMER CONFIDENCE March 97 Feb 97 March 96
Note - The index can vary between -100 and +100 points with zero as the neutral midpoint. A negative index value indicates a majority of the consumers polled by the CBS are pessimistic.
The total index is made up of two subindices which reflect consumers' feelings about the general economic climate and about their personal finances and spending plans:

CBS said consumer confidence again rose slightly in March, adding that consumer confidence in the first three months of 1997 was approaching the high levels of 1989 and 1990, a boom period for the Dutch economy.
